guides.noGuidesAvailable: No guides available for your role.
guides.bookingApproval.title: Process booking requests
guides.bookingApproval.description: Learn how to approve or reject booking requests
guides.bookingApproval.step1: Go to the Bookings page from the menu
guides.bookingApproval.step2: Find the request you want to process in the list
guides.bookingApproval.step3: Click on the request to see details
guides.bookingApproval.step4: Review information about the booker and time
guides.bookingApproval.step6: Select "Reject" with a reason to decline
guides.bookingApproval.step7: The user will automatically be notified of the result
guides.calendarView.title: Using the calendar
guides.calendarView.description: Overview of reservations for your assigned objects
guides.calendarView.step1: Go to Calendar from the menu
guides.calendarView.step2: Select view type: day, week, or month
guides.calendarView.step3: See all bookings for your assigned objects
guides.calendarView.step4: Click on a booking to see details
guides.calendarView.step5: Use filters to show specific objects
guides.calendarView.step6: Drag and drop to change time (if allowed)
guides.messages.title: Replying to messages
guides.messages.step1: Go to Messages from the menu
guides.messages.step2: Open the conversation you want to reply to
guides.messages.step3: Read the message history for context
guides.messages.step4: Write your reply in the text field
guides.messages.step6: Click Send to send the message
guides.userManagement.title: Managing users
guides.userManagement.description: Invite and manage users in your organization
guides.userManagement.step1: Go to the Users page from the menu
guides.userManagement.step2: Click "Invite user" to add a new user
guides.userManagement.step5: Assign rental objects the user should have access to
guides.userManagement.step6: Send the invitation - the user will receive an email
guides.rentalObjectCreate.title: Creating a rental object
guides.rentalObjectCreate.description: Add a new rental object to the system
guides.rentalObjectCreate.step1: Go to Rental Objects from the menu
guides.rentalObjectCreate.step3: Fill in basic information (name, description, category)
guides.rentalObjectCreate.step5: Set up availability and opening hours
guides.reportsExport.title: Generating reports
guides.reportsExport.step1: Go to Reports from the menu
guides.reportsExport.step4: Select which rental objects to include
guides.reportsExport.step6: Export to CSV or PDF as needed
